casebody.head_matter:
Joseph Edward McCONNEL, petitioner,
v.
UNITED STATES.
No. 12-9500.
Supreme Court of the United States
April 29, 2013.
Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until May 20, 2013, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
